neighbours.label: altering a rule, document or agreement ('may be amended / modified / changed', 'edit')
fire: This lease may be amended only with the consent of both parties.
The club's rules can be modified by a two-thirds vote of members.
Your privacy settings may be changed at any time from the account page.
The committee voted to amend the constitution last spring.
Draft invoices can still be edited before they are sent to the client.
The policy was modified after complaints from several customers.
If the council should change the parking rule, residents will be told.
No part of this contract may be altered without written approval.
quiet: This lease may be signed only in the presence of both parties.
The club's rules can be read on the notice board by all members.
Your privacy settings are shown at any time on the account page.
The committee voted to publish the constitution last spring.
Draft invoices can still be viewed before they are sent to the client.
The policy was praised by several customers in their reviews.
If the council should enforce the parking rule, residents will be told.
No part of this contract may be copied without written approval.

notes: Card top examples: ' modified' (EULA may be modified only by...), ' change' x4 (Legislature should change that rule), ' edit', ' different'. Weak pole (max 33). Probe: 'may be amended' 0.31, 'may be changed/modified' about 0.2, 'may be used' near 0. Near misses keep the legal/document register with a non-altering verb.
